hindi: और भी अधिक बल से — पहले मानी बात से और मजबूत आधार पर
definition: with even stronger reason, given what has already been granted
example: If she cannot afford the rent, then a fortiori she cannot afford a mortgage.

hindi: पूर्वसिद्ध — अनुभव से पहले, केवल तर्क से जाना हुआ
definition: known by reasoning alone, before any evidence is gathered
example: You cannot decide a priori which headline wins; run the test.

hindi: एकमात्र घातक कमज़ोरी — मज़बूती के बीच दुर्बल बिंदु
definition: a single fatal weakness in something otherwise strong
example: The engine is superb; the gearbox is its Achilles heel.

hindi: तदर्थ — केवल उसी एक काम के लिए, बिना स्थायी योजना
definition: made for one particular purpose, without any general plan
example: An ad hoc committee formed at noon and dissolved before tea.

hindi: व्यक्तिगत आक्षेप वाला — तर्क छोड़कर व्यक्ति पर हमला करने वाला
definition: attacking the person making an argument instead of the argument itself
example: The debate turned ad hominem the moment his numbers were questioned.

hindi: अनंत तक — बिना अंत के, लगातार
definition: continuing endlessly, with no stopping point in sight
example: The thread forked ad infinitum until nobody remembered the question.

hindi: उकताने की हद तक — इतनी बार कि जी भर जाए
definition: repeated so often that it becomes tiresome
example: We discussed the logo ad nauseam and shipped the first version anyway.

hindi: प्रमाण रूप में प्रस्तुत करना — दावे के समर्थन में देना
definition: to put something forward as evidence for a claim
example: He adduced three studies, two of which said the opposite of what he claimed.

hindi: संरक्षण — किसी शक्ति की छत्रछाया
definition: protection or sponsorship extended by a larger power
example: The trial runs under the aegis of the health ministry, which also pays for the coffee.

hindi: दूसरा स्वरूप — व्यक्ति का छिपा दूसरा रूप, या उसका अभिन्न विश्वासपात्र
definition: a second self, either another side of a person or a trusted intimate
example: By night the accountant became his alter ego, a fairly bad stand-up comic.

hindi: घोर वर्जित — जिससे सख़्त नफ़रत हो
definition: something detested and flatly rejected
example: Untested migrations are anathema to anyone who has been paged at three in the morning.

hindi: सहायक — मुख्य वस्तु का पूरक, गौण
definition: supporting the main thing without being part of it
example: The ancillary costs of travel, printing and coffee quietly doubled the budget.

hindi: चरम उत्कर्ष — देवत्व जैसी सर्वोच्च अवस्था
definition: the highest, near-divine form a thing can reach
example: That sandwich is the apotheosis of everything a lunch break can be.

hindi: अखाड़ा — मुकाबले का घिरा हुआ मैदान
definition: an enclosed space where contests are staged and watched
example: Politics is an arena, and the sand underfoot still soaks up whatever gets spilled.

hindi: रूखापन — बोली और स्वभाव की कठोरता
definition: harshness of tone or temper
example: She corrected the intern with an asperity the whole floor could hear.

hindi: महा-मलिन — जड़ से सफ़ाई माँगने वाला
definition: filthy or corrupt on a scale that demands a total clean-out
example: The new commissioner inherited an Augean department and a very small broom.

hindi: शकुन देना — आगामी परिणाम का संकेत होना
definition: to be a sign of how something is likely to turn out
example: A quiet first week augurs well for a term everyone expected to be loud.

hindi: संरक्षण — जिसके आश्रय और समर्थन में कोई काम हो
definition: the protection and sponsorship under which something is carried out
example: The talks resume under the auspices of the UN, and no birds were consulted.

hindi: लोभ — धन की अति और कंजूस लालसा
definition: an excessive, grasping desire for wealth
example: The estate was carved up in a single afternoon of open avarice.

hindi: स्वयंसिद्ध — जो बिना प्रमाण के सत्य माना जाए
definition: so obviously true that it is taken as a starting point, not proved
example: In this office it is axiomatic that the deadline will move at least once.

hindi: खरा — सच्चा और असली, धोखे की नीयत के बिना
definition: genuine, and undertaken without any intention to deceive
example: She turned out to be a bona fide expert, not a man with a slide deck.

hindi: अत्यंत जटिल और गूढ़ — उलझी, चालबाज़ व्यवस्था
definition: so intricate and devious that an outsider cannot follow it
example: The refund policy is Byzantine by design; nobody reaches the end of it.

hindi: उम्मीदवार — पद, नौकरी या चुनाव का प्रत्याशी
definition: someone formally seeking an office, a job, or a place
example: Every candidate turned up in the same bright white shirt, a habit older than they know.

hindi: आज का दिन जी लो — वर्तमान क्षण को हाथ से न जाने दो
definition: seize the present moment instead of saving it for later
example: He quit on Friday, bought a boat on Saturday, and called it carpe diem.

hindi: अनसुना चेतावनीकर्ता — सच कहने पर भी अविश्वसनीय
definition: one whose true warnings are never believed
example: He was the Cassandra of the flood report, and the city filed it away.

hindi: युद्ध का बहाना — जिस घटना को आधार बनाकर युद्ध छेड़ा जाए
definition: an act or event held up as the justification for going to war
example: The border skirmish was less a cause than a convenient casus belli.

hindi: रेचन — भावनाओं के बह जाने से मिली राहत
definition: emotional release that leaves a person lighter afterwards
example: Deleting the old codebase was less a cleanup than a catharsis.

hindi: चेतावनी — दावे की सीमा बताने वाली शर्त
definition: a warning that limits how far a claim should be trusted
example: The study is promising, with the caveat that it followed only forty people.

hindi: खरीदार सावधान — जाँच का जोखिम खरीदने वाले का
definition: the buyer carries the risk of checking what is being sold
example: The listing said 'as is', which is caveat emptor in two words.

hindi: काट-छाँट कर दबाना — प्रकाशन से पहले अंश रोकना
definition: to cut or suppress parts of something before the public can see it
example: The studio censored four minutes of the film and called it a creative decision.

hindi: मृगतृष्णा — असंभव कल्पना
definition: a hoped-for thing that proves impossible
example: A permanently clean inbox is a chimera he keeps chasing anyway.

hindi: कपोल-कल्पित — केवल कल्पना में संभव
definition: existing only in imagination; wildly improbable
example: The plan to power the whole city on tides by spring was frankly chimerical.

hindi: क्षमादान — दंड देने की शक्ति रखते हुए दिखाई गई दया
definition: mercy shown by someone holding the power to punish
example: The governor granted clemency eleven hours before the sentence was due.

hindi: सहवर्ती — साथ-साथ घटित होने वाला
definition: happening alongside something else and bound up with it
example: Growth came with the concomitant problem of nobody knowing anyone's name.

hindi: उपसिद्धांत — सिद्ध बात से स्वतः निकलने वाला परिणाम
definition: something that follows automatically from what has already been established
example: The corollary of trusting your team is having to live with their decisions.

hindi: ब्रह्मांड — व्यवस्थित समग्र सृष्टि
definition: the universe understood as an ordered whole
example: A clear night in the desert makes the cosmos feel closer than the nearest town.

hindi: व्यवहारतः — नियम से नहीं, पर असल में ऐसा ही
definition: existing in fact, whether or not any rule or title recognises it
example: He has no title, but he is the de facto head of the department.

hindi: विधितः — कानून की दृष्टि से, चाहे व्यवहार में न हो
definition: existing by law, whether or not it holds in practice
example: The office is de jure hers; the corner desk is still someone else's.

hindi: भारी क्षति पहुँचाना — बड़े हिस्से का नाश करना
definition: to destroy or remove a large part of something
example: The layoffs decimated the team, and nobody stopped to count who was the tenth.

hindi: द्व्यर्थी और रहस्यमय — जान-बूझकर अस्पष्ट
definition: deliberately obscure, and open to more than one reading
example: The chairman's Delphic memo let both factions claim he agreed with them.

hindi: आकस्मिक उद्धारक — कहानी को बाहर से आकर सुलझाने वाला असंभव संयोग
definition: an improbable rescue that resolves a story from outside its own logic
example: The finale's deus ex machina arrived as a long-lost uncle with a cheque.

hindi: अत्यंत कठोर — अपराध से कहीं बड़ा दंड
definition: harsh and severe out of all proportion to the offence
example: The attendance rules are draconian: one late train and you lose a day's pay.

hindi: दोहरापन — मुँह पर कुछ और मन में कुछ रखना
definition: double-dealing; saying one thing while intending another
example: The emails revealed a duplicity that no apology was going to cover.

hindi: परमानंददायी — स्वर्गिक शांति और सौंदर्य वाला
definition: blissfully peaceful and beautiful
example: Three days on that quiet coast were Elysian, and then the phone found me.

hindi: अवकाशप्राप्त सम्मानित — पद छोड़कर भी उपाधि धारण किए हुए
definition: retired from a post but keeping its title as a mark of honour
example: Professor emeritus: no teaching, no committees, and the parking space survives.

hindi: पहेली — जो समझ में न आए
definition: someone or something that resists explanation
example: The bug is an enigma: it fails only on Tuesdays, and only in Berlin.

hindi: मूर्त रूप — किसी गुण का सर्वोत्तम उदाहरण
definition: the purest example of a quality
example: Her reply, three words and no greeting, was the epitome of a busy inbox.

hindi: समता — विचलित हुए बिना संतुलित बना रहने वाला मन
definition: calmness and evenness of mind, especially under strain
example: He took the news of the layoffs with an equanimity nobody else in the room shared.

hindi: अतः — इसलिए, निष्कर्ष रूप में
definition: and so, used to mark the conclusion an argument has earned
example: He was in Delhi that night, ergo he cannot have signed the register in Pune.

hindi: मूल स्वभाव — समूह के मार्गदर्शक मूल्य
definition: the guiding character and values of a group
example: The company ethos survives exactly as long as someone keeps saying it out loud.

hindi: भूतलक्षी — बीत चुकी बात पर बाद में लागू किया गया
definition: applied to things already done, after the fact
example: An ex post facto rule cannot punish what was perfectly legal last year.

hindi: राजकोषीय — सरकारी धन, कर और व्यय से संबंधित
definition: relating to public money and how a government raises and spends it
example: Fiscal discipline lasts exactly until the first opinion poll of an election year.

hindi: धैर्य-साहस — कष्ट और कठिनाई में डटे रहने का बल
definition: courage and steadiness in the face of pain or long difficulty
example: Six months of chemotherapy borne with a fortitude the whole ward noticed.

hindi: मंच — खुली सार्वजनिक चर्चा का स्थान
definition: a public place or occasion for open discussion of shared business
example: The town holds its angriest debates in an online forum, having sold off the square.

hindi: दुर्भेद्य उलझन वाला — धीरज से न सुलझने वाला
definition: so tangled that no patient method will undo it
example: She cut the Gordian knot: fire the vendor, rebuild it in-house.

hindi: गांभीर्य — व्यक्तित्व में गंभीरता और वज़न
definition: a weight of seriousness and dignity in bearing
example: The role needed gravitas, and she brought it the moment she sat down.

hindi: बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण — बंदी को अदालत के सामने पेश कराने का अधिकार
definition: the right to have a detained person brought before a court
example: The family filed for habeas corpus when the police stopped answering.

hindi: धमकाना — ऊँची आवाज़ में डाँट-डपट करना
definition: to bully with loud, blustering talk
example: Stop hectoring the intern; she has the numbers and you have the volume.

hindi: वर्चस्व — एक शक्ति का दूसरों पर दबदबा
definition: the dominance one power holds over others
example: English hegemony online decides which jokes travel and which stay home.

hindi: अतिदुष्कर — विराट बल या श्रम माँगने वाला
definition: demanding enormous strength or effort
example: Rewriting the payroll system in six weeks was a Herculean ask.

hindi: अहंकार — पतन को न्योता देता दंभ
definition: overreaching pride that invites its own downfall
example: Shipping on Friday with no rollback plan is hubris, and Monday collects the bill.

hindi: अनुपस्थिति में — संबंधित व्यक्ति के बिना उपस्थित हुए
definition: while the person concerned is not present
example: He was sentenced in absentia and is believed to be somewhere in Dubai.

hindi: अभिभावक के स्थान पर — माता-पिता की जगह उनकी ज़िम्मेदारी निभाते हुए
definition: standing in a parent's place, with a parent's responsibilities
example: Boarding schools act in loco parentis, which is a heavy thing to promise.

hindi: कथा के मध्य से — घटना बीच में पहुँच चुकी हो वहाँ से शुरू
definition: beginning in the middle of the action rather than at the start
example: The novel opens in medias res, with the getaway car already on fire.

hindi: यथास्थान — अपनी मूल जगह पर ही
definition: in the original place, without being moved
example: The mosaic was cleaned in situ, an inch at a time, over two summers.

hindi: आलस्य — परिश्रम से बचने की जमी हुई प्रवृत्ति
definition: settled laziness; a disinclination to exert oneself
example: Two summers of pure indolence, and he still calls it a sabbatical.

hindi: अटल — जिसे रोका या मनाया न जा सके
definition: impossible to stop, slow down, or talk out of its course
example: The math was inexorable: at that burn rate the company had eleven months left.

hindi: अन्य बातों के साथ — और भी कई बातों के बीच
definition: among other things, when only a few of them are being named
example: The report criticises, inter alia, the catering budget.

hindi: स्वतः ही — उसी तथ्य से अपने आप
definition: by that fact alone, with nothing further needing to be shown
example: Missing three meetings does not ipso facto mean he has quit.

hindi: श्रेय और प्रशंसा — काम की सराहना
definition: credit and praise earned for something achieved
example: Kudos to whoever fixed the printer without telling anyone.

hindi: कीर्ति — पूर्व उपलब्धियों से अर्जित सम्मान
definition: honours earned by past achievement and enjoyed ever since
example: Two hits in a decade, and he has been resting on his laurels for nine years of it.

hindi: उदारमनस्कता — विरोधी के प्रति भी दिखाया गया बड़प्पन
definition: generosity of spirit, especially toward a rival or a beaten foe
example: His magnanimity in defeat won him more supporters than the campaign ever had.

hindi: कृति-शिरोमणि — जीवन भर का सबसे बड़ा और श्रेष्ठ काम
definition: the greatest work of an artist's or writer's life
example: Forty years of notes finally became a magnum opus nobody could lift.

hindi: उन्माद — जुनूनी सनक या उत्तेजना
definition: an obsessive enthusiasm that takes hold of a person or a crowd
example: The office caught a brief mania for standing desks, then quietly sat back down.

hindi: लंबी थकाऊ दौड़ — सहनशक्ति की परीक्षा
definition: an endurance test of exhausting length
example: The budget session became a marathon: nineteen hours and one working microphone.

hindi: रणसंबंधी — युद्ध या सैनिक से जुड़ा
definition: having to do with war, or befitting a soldier
example: The parade ended with martial drums and a very civilian queue for tea.

hindi: मक़बरा — भव्य समाधि-भवन
definition: a grand building raised to house a tomb
example: The empty mall has the hush of a mausoleum with escalators.

hindi: मेरी भूल — अपनी गलती की खुली स्वीकारोक्ति
definition: an open admission that the fault was your own
example: The apology began as a mea culpa and ended up blaming the vendor.

hindi: मृत्यु-स्मारक — मरणशीलता की याद दिलाने वाली वस्तु
definition: a reminder that you will die, kept deliberately in view
example: The cracked phone screen served as a small daily memento mori.

hindi: मिथ्यावादिता — झूठ बोलने की पक्की आदत
definition: the habit of lying; untruthfulness as a settled trait
example: The inquiry exposed a mendacity running through every quarterly report.

hindi: चंचल स्वभाव — पल-पल बदलता मिज़ाज
definition: quick to change in mood or manner, and hard to predict
example: A mercurial editor: lavish praise on Monday, silence for the rest of the week.

hindi: सोना बना देने वाला हाथ — हर काम मुनाफ़े में बदलने की क्षमता
definition: a knack for turning everything one handles into profit
example: Three hits in a row and the press decided she had the Midas touch.

hindi: कार्यप्रणाली — काम करने का चिर-परिचित तरीका
definition: a person's characteristic way of doing something
example: Charm first, invoice later, vanish by spring: that was his modus operandi.

hindi: उदारता — दान देने में असाधारण दरियादिली
definition: great generosity in giving
example: The new library exists entirely because of one alumna's munificence.

hindi: यथावश्यक परिवर्तन सहित — ज़रूरी बदलाव करके, बाकी ज्यों का त्यों
definition: with the necessary changes made and everything else left as it was
example: The same clause applies to the Delhi office, mutatis mutandis.

hindi: आत्ममोह — स्वयं पर अत्यधिक मुग्धता
definition: excessive absorption in oneself and one's own image
example: The memoir's narcissism is total: even the earthquake is about him.

hindi: अपरिहार्य प्रतिद्वंद्वी — जिससे बचा न जा सके
definition: an opponent or downfall that cannot be escaped
example: Spreadsheets were his nemesis long before the audit made it official.

hindi: असंगत कथन — पिछली बात से न जुड़ने वाली टिप्पणी
definition: a statement that does not follow from what came before
example: He answered a question about rent with a non sequitur about his childhood dog.

hindi: हठधर्मिता — टस से मस न होने वाली जिद
definition: stubborn refusal to be moved, softened, or persuaded
example: The negotiations died on the obduracy of a single shareholder.

hindi: टाल देना — आवश्यकता ही समाप्त कर देना
definition: to remove the need for something before it can arise
example: A single sentence in the contract would have obviated the entire lawsuit.

hindi: लंबी घटनापूर्ण यात्रा — कठिनाइयों से भरी
definition: a long, eventful journey full of trials
example: Getting the visa turned into a nine-month odyssey through four consulates.

hindi: उच्चासीन और निर्लिप्त — सामान्य चिंताओं से ऊपर
definition: lofty and detached, as though above ordinary concerns
example: He dismissed the complaint with Olympian calm and never read the second page.

hindi: दिखावटी — जो कारण कहा गया हो, पर असली न हो
definition: stated as the reason, though probably not the real one
example: The ostensible purpose of the meeting was planning; the real one was blame.

hindi: करतल ध्वनि — खड़े होकर की गई तालियों की लंबी गूँज
definition: a sustained burst of applause from a crowd on its feet
example: She got a standing ovation, which is the lesser honour and still the louder one.

hindi: रामबाण — हर मर्ज़ का एक ही इलाज
definition: a single cure imagined to fix every ailment
example: Standups are not a panacea; a broken plan stays broken at nine in the morning.

hindi: समूची श्रृंखला — प्रभावशाली पूरा साज़-सामान
definition: a full and impressive array of things
example: She boarded with a panoply of chargers for a two-hour flight.

hindi: देवमंडल — किसी क्षेत्र के सर्वोच्च नाम
definition: the set of figures a field honours above all others
example: Her second album put her in the pantheon of artists we argue about at weddings.

hindi: प्रतिमान — सोच और कार्य का ढाँचा
definition: the pattern of assumptions a field works inside
example: Remote work broke the old paradigm and nobody has finished writing the new one.

hindi: कृपणता — खर्च करने में अति कंजूसी
definition: extreme unwillingness to spend money
example: The department's parsimony extended to rationing the printer paper.

hindi: करुण भाव — दया और दुःख जगाने वाला गुण
definition: the quality in something that stirs pity or sorrow
example: The ad reaches for pathos with a dog, a suitcase, and one piano chord.

hindi: कुलीन — पुराने अभिजात वर्ग के ढंग और संस्कार वाला
definition: having the manner or breeding of a long-established upper class
example: His patrician drawl has survived four decades in a party that claims to hate it.

hindi: स्वयं में — अपने आप में, अन्य संदर्भ हटाकर
definition: in itself, considered apart from anything connected to it
example: The app isn't slow per se; the network it trusts is.

hindi: विश्वासघात — भरोसे या वचन को जानबूझकर तोड़ना
definition: deliberate betrayal of trust or of a promise given
example: Selling the client list to a rival was perfidy, not ambition.

hindi: अवांछित व्यक्ति — जिसका आना अब स्वीकार्य नहीं
definition: someone no longer welcome in a place or group
example: One leaked memo made her persona non grata at head office.

hindi: भीति — कारण से कहीं बड़ा डर
definition: a fear far out of proportion to the thing feared
example: His phobia of public speaking survives every workshop the company pays for.

hindi: पुनर्जीवित — राख से फिर उठ खड़ा होने वाला
definition: something that rises restored from its own destruction
example: The mill closed in 1998 and reopened as a phoenix of glass and coffee shops.

hindi: जनसाधारण का — आम लोगों जैसा, अपरिष्कृत
definition: belonging to or suited to ordinary people; lacking refinement
example: He apologised for his plebeian taste in films, then defended it for a full hour.

hindi: बहुतायत — ज़रूरत से कहीं ज़्यादा भरमार
definition: an amount so large it becomes a problem of its own
example: There is a plethora of dashboards and not one answer to the actual question.

hindi: अंगरक्षक-वर्गीय — नेता की रक्षा और नियंत्रण करने वाले विशिष्ट दल का
definition: belonging to an elite guard that protects a leader and often controls him
example: A praetorian ring of aides decides who ever reaches the chief executive.

hindi: अनिश्चित और अस्थिर — किसी भी क्षण ढह जाने योग्य
definition: unsteady and liable to collapse or fail at any moment
example: The coalition is precarious: three spare votes, two large egos, one bad news cycle.

hindi: प्रथम दृष्टया — पहली नज़र में सही जान पड़ने वाला
definition: true or sufficient on first impression, unless later disproved
example: The court found a prima facie case and let the trial go ahead.

hindi: नि:शुल्क — जनहित में, बिना फीस लिए किया गया
definition: done professionally without charge, usually for the public good
example: She takes two pro bono cases a year and loses sleep over both.

hindi: सत्यनिष्ठा — पूरी ईमानदारी, विशेषकर पैसे और पद के मामलों में
definition: complete honesty and uprightness, especially where money or power is involved
example: Thirty years on the bench and not one question about his probity.

hindi: जबरन ढाँचे में कसने वाला — नुक़सान की परवाह किए बिना
definition: forcing things to fit a fixed scheme, whatever the damage
example: Grading on a strict curve is procrustean: someone must fail so the shape holds.

hindi: अपव्यय-उच्छृंखलता — बेतहाशा फिजूलखर्ची या निर्लज्ज दुराचार
definition: reckless extravagance with money
example: A decade of profligacy left the club with trophies and no money.

hindi: साहसी सर्जक — निषेध तोड़कर नया देने वाला
definition: boldly original, and willing to defy authority to bring something new
example: The lab's Promethean streak gave the world a cure and a decade of lawsuits.

hindi: बहुरूपी — अनेक रूप धारण करने वाला
definition: endlessly changeable; able to take many forms or roles
example: A protean actor who plays the villain, the priest, and the dog in one season.

hindi: शर्त — किसी सहमति के साथ जुड़ी अनिवार्य बात
definition: a condition attached to an agreement
example: She agreed, with the proviso that she would never be asked to travel on weekends.

hindi: कथित — जो माना जाता हो पर सिद्ध न हो
definition: generally supposed to be so, without having been proved
example: The putative author of the leak turned out to be on leave that entire week.

hindi: आत्मघाती विजय-सा — हार जैसी महँगी जीत
definition: won at a cost so ruinous the victory is hardly worth having
example: They won the case and lost the company: a Pyrrhic victory in three volumes.

hindi: लेन-देन — बदले में कुछ मिलने की शर्त पर किया गया उपकार
definition: a favour given on the understanding that something comes back
example: The email made the quid pro quo explicit, which is why it became evidence.

hindi: लुटेरी लालसा — निर्ममता से हड़प लेने की वृत्ति
definition: predatory greed that takes without scruple
example: The rapacity of the asset strippers left nothing behind but the brand name.

hindi: नैतिक सत्यता — आचरण की सीधाई, सही राह पर अडिग रहना
definition: strict adherence to what is right in judgment and conduct
example: She ran the charity with a rectitude that made the auditors almost redundant.

hindi: खंडन करना — प्रमाण से गलत सिद्ध करना
definition: to prove a claim wrong by evidence or argument
example: One clean counterexample refuted a theory that had stood for a decade.

hindi: मृत्यु-कठोरता — मरने के कुछ घंटों बाद देह का अकड़ जाना
definition: the stiffening of the body some hours after death
example: Rigor mortis gave the pathologist a rough window for the time of death.

hindi: व्याख्यान-मंच — वक्ता या संचालक का ऊँचा चबूतरा
definition: a raised platform for a speaker or a conductor
example: She stepped up to the rostrum, once a stage decked with the beaks of captured ships.

hindi: निर्णायक सीमा — जिसे पार करने पर लौटना असंभव
definition: a boundary that, once crossed, allows no going back
example: Sending that resignation email was his Rubicon, and the server sent it twice.

hindi: प्रज्ञा — व्यावहारिक बुद्धि और गहरी सूझबूझ
definition: keen practical wisdom and sound judgment
example: Her sagacity in a crisis was worth more than the whole strategy deck.

hindi: वेतन — नियमित काम के बदले तयशुदा नियत आय
definition: fixed pay for regular work, quoted by the year and drawn by the month
example: The salary looked generous until he divided it by the hours actually worked.

hindi: प्रमुख — जो सबसे उभरकर ध्यान खींचे
definition: standing out as the most noticeable or important part
example: Skip the history and give me the salient points before the client calls.

hindi: उदास और गंभीर — रूखा, मंद स्वभाव
definition: gloomy and grave in temper, slow to warm
example: He had a saturnine face that made even his compliments sound like warnings.

hindi: अनिश्चित काल के लिए — बिना अगली तारीख तय किए
definition: with no future date fixed for resuming
example: The House was adjourned sine die after ninety minutes of shouting.

hindi: अनिवार्य शर्त — जिसके बिना काम असंभव हो
definition: something absolutely essential, without which the thing cannot exist
example: Trust is the sine qua non of a partnership that survives its first bad quarter.

hindi: अनिष्टसूचक — जिसमें छिपा हुआ अहित जान पड़े
definition: giving the impression that something harmful is quietly at work
example: Nothing about the offer looked sinister until the second page, on the left.

hindi: मोहक विनाशिका — लुभाकर संकट में डालने वाली
definition: something alluring that draws you toward ruin
example: Cheap credit was the siren that sank three of his shops.

hindi: निष्फल परिश्रम-भरा — जो कभी पूरा ही न हो
definition: endlessly laborious and doomed to yield nothing
example: Clearing that inbox is Sisyphean; by lunch it has filled again.

hindi: सादा और कठोर — सुख-सुविधा से रहित
definition: plain, bare, and stripped of all comfort
example: His flat was spartan: a bed, a lamp, and forty books stacked on the floor.

hindi: भ्रामक — ऊपर से ठीक दिखने वाला पर वस्तुतः गलत
definition: looking sound at first glance but false underneath
example: It is a specious argument: every step is clean except the one that matters.

hindi: मिथ्या — नकली, या झूठे संबंध वाला
definition: not genuine, or not really connected to what it claims
example: The correlation is spurious; both lines are just following the weather.

hindi: यथास्थिति — जो व्यवस्था इस समय चली आ रही है
definition: the existing state of affairs, especially when someone wants it kept
example: Every committee says it wants change and then votes for the status quo.

hindi: गरजदार — अत्यंत ऊँची और भारी आवाज़ वाला
definition: extremely loud and powerful in voice
example: A stentorian 'order!' from the chair ended the shouting instantly.

hindi: कलंक — किसी बात से चिपकी बदनामी
definition: a mark of disgrace attached to a condition or a choice
example: The stigma around therapy fades a little each time someone admits they go.

hindi: घोर अंधकारमय — भयावह काला
definition: utterly dark, and gloomy with it
example: The tunnel lights failed and left us in Stygian dark for twenty minutes.

hindi: विचाराधीन — अदालत में लंबित, इसलिए सार्वजनिक चर्चा वर्जित
definition: still before a court, and so not to be discussed publicly
example: The anchor kept saying the matter was sub judice, and kept discussing it.

hindi: गुप्त रूप से — चुपचाप, बिना किसी को बताए
definition: in secret, and understood by everyone present to stay that way
example: The merger talks ran sub rosa for four months before anyone leaked them.

hindi: अंतर्भूत करना — बड़े वर्ग के भीतर समेट लेना
definition: to include something within a larger category or principle
example: The smaller complaints were subsumed under one heading and quietly forgotten.

hindi: अपने ढंग का अकेला — जिसकी कोई श्रेणी ही न बने
definition: in a class of its own, resembling nothing else
example: The building is sui generis, and the neighbours have opinions about it.

hindi: संगोष्ठी — विशेषज्ञों की चर्चा-सभा
definition: a meeting where specialists present and discuss their work
example: The symposium ran late because two professors disagreed politely for an hour.

hindi: कोरी स्लेट — जिस पर अभी कुछ लिखा न गया हो
definition: a blank state carrying nothing written on it yet
example: A new team is never a tabula rasa; everyone arrives with an old grudge.

hindi: मौन — बिना कहे समझा और स्वीकार किया गया
definition: understood and accepted without ever being said aloud
example: There was a tacit agreement that nobody would mention the failed launch.

hindi: ललचाना — पास दिखाकर पहुँच से दूर रखना
definition: to tease by keeping something wanted just out of reach
example: The menu tantalized us for an hour before the kitchen admitted it had closed.

hindi: दुस्साहस — जोखिम और मर्यादा की परवाह किए बिना की गई ढिठाई
definition: reckless boldness; nerve that ignores the risk or the offence
example: He had the temerity to ask for a raise the week after the outage.

hindi: संयम — भोग और इच्छाओं में आत्म-नियंत्रण
definition: moderation and self-restraint, especially in appetite
example: His idea of temperance was one dessert instead of three.

hindi: समर्थनीय — जिसका बचाव किया जा सके
definition: able to be defended against objection
example: After the third contradiction, his position was no longer tenable.

hindi: ठोस भूमि — पैरों तले की पक्की ज़मीन
definition: solid ground, felt as a relief after sea or air
example: After nine hours of turbulence, terra firma felt like a personal favour.

hindi: विराट — आकार, शक्ति या महत्वाकांक्षा में विशाल
definition: enormous in size, force, or ambition
example: It took a titanic effort to get the bridge open before the monsoon.

hindi: विजयोत्सव — बड़ी जीत और उसका उल्लास
definition: a great victory, or the public elation that follows one
example: He called the merger a triumph and paraded it through three press conferences.

hindi: छद्म उपहार — भीतर छिपे आक्रमण वाला
definition: a gift or disguise that carries a hidden attack inside
example: The free plugin was a Trojan horse and shipped a keylogger with it.

hindi: नैतिक पतन — घोर अनैतिक और नीच आचरण
definition: depravity; conduct that is basely immoral
example: The visa was refused on grounds of moral turpitude.

hindi: अधिकार-क्षेत्र से बाहर — कानूनी शक्ति की सीमा लाँघकर किया गया
definition: beyond the legal power of the person or body acting
example: The court struck the order down as ultra vires the parent statute.

hindi: घूसखोरी — रिश्वत के लिए बिक जाने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: willingness to be bribed; being for sale where one should not be
example: The venality of the licensing office was an open secret and a fixed price.

hindi: सत्यवादिता — सच बोलने की आदत, कथन की सच्चाई
definition: habitual truthfulness, or the accuracy of a statement
example: Nobody doubted his sincerity; the veracity of his numbers was another matter.

hindi: और इसके उलट भी — दोनों पक्ष बदल कर भी वही बात
definition: with the two things just mentioned swapped around
example: Designers should sit with support for a week, and vice versa.

hindi: खलनायक — कहानी या घटना का दुष्ट पात्र
definition: the character or person whose wrongdoing drives the trouble
example: Every founder's story needs a villain, and it is never the man telling the story.

hindi: जनमत — आम लोगों की सामूहिक आवाज़
definition: the opinion of ordinary people taken as a whole
example: Polling is an attempt to hear the vox populi without leaving the office.
